record.name: Mónika Papp
record.title: Senior Research Associate
record.bio: Mónika Papp completed her undergraduate and master's studies in Mathematics and Computer Science at the University of Novi Sad, Faculty of Sciences, graduating in 2005 and 2007 respectively. She earned her PhD in 2013 with a dissertation on cross-lingual sentence alignment in multilingual legal corpora. After a postdoctoral stay at the University of Ljubljana (2014–2015), she returned to Novi Sad as a Research Associate and was promoted to Senior Research Associate in 2020. Her group focuses on multilingual natural language processing, with particular emphasis on transformer-based semantic similarity, named-entity alignment, and structured document reconciliation across typologically diverse languages. She teaches courses in computational linguistics and machine learning for text data. The group uses GPU-equipped workstations and accesses HPC resources through the Institute of Mathematics of the Serbian Academy of Sciences.
open_to: contract research on document matching and data reconciliation
consulting on multilingual NLP system design
record.industry_experience: Papp carried out a six-month applied research engagement with a regional insurance company (2018–2019) focused on automated cross-lingual matching of damage-claim documents submitted in Serbian and Hungarian. The engagement resulted in a prototype system deployed internally by the company.
record.notes: Papp is currently at full teaching load and can take on new projects only from late 2025 onward. She has a strong preference for projects with a clearly defined applied component and real multilingual document data rather than purely benchmark-oriented work.
